title: Bottle轻量Web工作场景
description: 固定真实源码上的完整工程交付：在原生文件入口识别真实PathLike并保持流所有权；隔离模板引擎和实例的默认扩展名搜索；前缀克隆合并原生路由并保留来源应用；安全设置响应charset并影响实际字符串编码；原子或排他发布上传文件并恢复输入位置；输出不执行回调且不泄漏配置的真实路由清单。每项均包含调查、方案确认、实现、独立验收及失败返工；原项目研究另保留。

scenarios.title: 在原生文件入口识别真实PathLike并保持流所有权
scenarios.goal: 在原生文件入口识别真实PathLike并保持流所有权

tasks.goal: 在原生文件入口识别真实PathLike并保持流所有权
tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Extend FileUpload.save, static_file, BaseTemplate name/lookup and ResourceManager.add_path boundaries to accept str/bytes/os.PathLike via os.fspath/fsdecode, including custom PathLike and Unicode. Distinguish real paths from writable streams, support upload target directories and one directory lookup input, preserve caller stream ownership/cursor and existing file conflict/static containment rules. Invalid __fspath__ return types must fail instead of being stringified. Do not reinterpret template source text as filenames.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/test/test_development_bottle_o01_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-bottle-o01-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Extend Bottle.merge(routes, prefix=None). None must preserve legacy route identity/owner. An explicit absolute prefix clones routes with target ownership, copied route-specific plugins/skip/config and original callback, normalizes trailing slashes and supports dynamic built-in filters/reverse URLs without changing source rules. Target app plugin policy applies to clones, source app plugins are not implicitly copied. Reject bad prefixes and duplicate route names before adding any clones; preserve original source registration and callback behavior.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/test/test_development_bottle_o03_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-bottle-o03-dev.md.
